subject: Establishment of Municipal Parking Department Operations
overview: The Council approved five-year contracts for parking vehicles and data management systems and established several new municipal parking and planning positions. Much of the meeting focused on the city's transition to in-house parking enforcement following the expiration of a private vendor contract.

items.title: Traffic and Infrastructure Resolutions
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting a traffic safety evaluation at the intersection of Harvard Street and Mystic Avenue and road repairs at 31 Wildwood Road.

items.title: Common Victualler License: Petey's Pizza
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for Forest Center Enterprises, Inc., doing business as Petey's Pizza, at 336 Boston Avenue.

items.title: Parking Department Contracts
items.summary: Approved five-year contracts with Enterprise Fleet Management for enforcement vehicles and GT Techno USA Corporation for a data management system. Members debated the lack of a formal transition plan from the current vendor and questioned the financial necessity of a five-year commitment over a three-year term.

items.title: Parking Department Personnel Ordinance
items.summary: Approved the first reading of amendments to the personnel ordinance to create positions for parking control specialists, meter repair persons, and foremen. The administration noted that these roles would be funded through existing budgets and department revenue.

items.title: Referral of ARPA-Funded Positions
items.summary: Referred several proposed positions funded by the American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) to the Committee of the Whole to allow for a review of the city's broader spending plan. Health officials advocated for the immediate need for these roles to support ongoing pandemic response and community outreach.

items.title: Planning and Health Personnel Amendments
items.summary: Approved first readings of personnel amendments establishing a CDBG Administrator, Staff Planner, and Community Recovery Coach. Officials clarified that several of these positions were previously existing or grant-funded but required formal classification in the compensation plan.

items.title: Committee Reports and Procedural Matters
items.summary: Accepted a committee report regarding the City Clerk's office, ruled a public participation request out of order, and voted to cancel the December 28 meeting.
